spec.label: JUDGMENT
spec.source: JUDGMENT: engineering judgment fixed by the coordinator in docs/PLAN_M5_M8.md, section 'M8 uncertainty' (2026-10-07), revised by 'Amendment R4' (R4-5, R4-6; 2026-10-13). These 1-sigma widths are NOT published values; NASA's NESC F-16 package gives no uncertainty for its aerodynamic tables.
spec.rationale: Damping (rotary) derivatives are less certain than static tables, so their sigma is doubled (0.10 vs 0.05).
spec.distribution: independent normal N(1, sigma) per multiplier (Monte Carlo)
judgments: JUDGMENT: Cm_basic and Cm_de are treated as independent, although both come from one wind-tunnel table (cmt): the split (amendment R4-5) is an aero-database build-up, and a correlation between the static part and the elevator increment is not modelled.

PRECONDITION: every assessed condition is a 1-g, wings-level, gamma = 0, beta = 0 trim; the longitudinal-only search (R3-M3(a)) and the lateral groups without Cm_q (R4-9) rely on it, and their runtime gates check one point per group (the critical condition) only. A turning or sideslipping condition would invalidate both.
JUDGMENT: the multipliers are independent normal N(1, sigma) with the JUDGMENT sigmas; the CSR headline does not depend on this distribution, only the Monte Carlo and the k_g box do.

validity.description: NESC F16_package README (data/nesc/extracted/Atmospheric_models/F16_package/F16_package/README/README.html, line 910, Assumptions and Limitations): "Flight envelope is limited to the vicinity of 10,000 ft MSL and 287.8 knots equivalent airspeed"; the LQR section adds that flight at other speed/altitude combinations may be sub-optimal or even unstable.
validity.judgment: JUDGMENT (agent fq, 2026-10-05; the README gives no radius): IN = |h - 10,000 ft| <= 5,000 ft and |KEAS - 287.8| <= 20 % (230.24-345.36 KEAS), CG not restricted (20-30 % MAC accepted). Points outside are EXTRAPOLATED: their Levels are reported separately and are indicative only (review R2 M8).
